summary.zh: 从现有代码还原需求，产出产品需求文档
summary.en: Reverse-engineers a PRD from an existing codebase

description.zh: 读取现有代码库，梳理页面、字段、路由和接口，反推出对应的功能需求，并生成产品需求文档的初稿。适合接手遗留项目、给老系统补文档，或在新成员加入前整理现状。需要能访问代码仓库。
description.en: Reads an existing codebase, maps its pages, fields, routes and endpoints, reverse-engineers the requirements and scaffolds a product spec. Useful for inherited projects, undocumented systems or onboarding. Needs repo access.
